ideas.title: Idea hatching pipeline — knowledge → idea → hatched project repo
ideas.ecosystem_gap: Knowledge processing surfaces ideas, but no systematic path from idea → scoped project → forked repo exists.
ideas.description: Design the pipeline: idea-scout surfaces gaps → community champions emerge → idea becomes approved → dev repo hatches from template.

ideas.title: Non-tech operator UX — web + chat onboarding
ideas.ecosystem_gap: Current bootstrap requires CLI + GitHub literacy. Most regenerative org operators are not developers.
ideas.description: Web-based wizard (GitHub Actions backend) + chat interface (Telegram bot) that wraps bootstrap-interviewer skill. Scoping plan exists at docs/agent-plans/non-tech-onboarding.md.

ideas.title: Bidirectional Notion ↔ YAML sync
ideas.ecosystem_gap: Operators prefer editing in Notion; agents read YAML. Manual sync breaks quickly.
ideas.description: Design bidirectional sync between Notion databases and data/*.yaml with conflict resolution and schema validation on both sides.

ideas.title: Federation at scale — 10+ nodes with routing
ideas.ecosystem_gap: Current federation.yaml handles small networks. 10+ nodes need skill-sharing protocols, knowledge routing, trust delegation.
ideas.description: Design patterns for larger federations: namespace isolation, skill package registries, trust chains.

ideas.title: Autoresearch evaluation metrics
ideas.ecosystem_gap: workspace-improver runs an autonomous loop, but no objective criteria decide what counts as improvement.
ideas.description: Define measurable metrics: schema validation pass rate, memory recency, HEARTBEAT completion rate, instance drift. Feed into workspace-improver's evaluation step.

ideas.title: Promote `research` skill to framework
ideas.ecosystem_gap: `research` skill exists in refi-bcn-os and refi-dao-os but not in framework. Two instances validate the pattern — promotion criteria met.
ideas.description: Reconcile the two implementations, extract the common core into skills/research/SKILL.md, instances migrate to framework version on next sync.

ideas.title: Promote DAO-module skills to framework
ideas.ecosystem_gap: safe-treasury, hats-governance, gardens-governance, karma-reputation, eip4824-identity exist only in dao-os. Framework has no treasury/governance-protocol skills despite supporting DAO-type instances.
ideas.description: Evaluate each skill for generality. Promote those that serve any DAO-type instance. Keep dao-os-specific composer logic in dao-os.

ideas.title: Document cross-instance data-registry extension pattern
ideas.ecosystem_gap: refi-bcn-os adds tasks/pending-payouts/telegram-topic-routing; refi-dao-os adds blog-articles/entities/tasks/website-source-mapping. Instances extend the canonical 13 registries but the pattern isn't documented — new instances reinvent.
ideas.description: Document in docs/DATA-MODEL.md how to add instance-specific registries without breaking framework validation. Consider: namespace prefix, validation opt-in, schema extension.

ideas.title: Multica x org-os integration pilot
ideas.ecosystem_gap: org-os agent workflows run locally; Multica provides an issue/agent orchestration platform, but the integration surface between the two — how issues drive org-os operator runs, how memory/HEARTBEAT stay coherent across the boundary — has not been piloted.
ideas.description: Pilot the Multica ↔ org-os integration: agent identity, session discipline, branch conventions, comment-as-deliverable output surface. Validate on a small set of smoke issues, then document the pattern for other org-os instances.
